Institution: Secretariat of the Basel, Rotterdam and Stockholm Conventions (BRS)
Subject Matter Jurisdiction (verbatim): The BRS Secretariat is responsible for facilitating the implementation of the Basel, Rotterdam and Stockholm conventions, which aim to protect human health and the environment from hazardous chemicals and wastes ( This includes providing administrative, technical and legal support to the parties and their subsidiary bodies, as well as receiving and conveying information from and to the parties. The BRS Secretariat also coordinates with other international bodies and stakeholders, and delivers capacity-building, awareness-raising and outreach activities for the sound management of chemicals and wastes, in line with the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. The BRS Secretariat contributes to the protection of the marine environment and the law of the sea by preventing and combating illegal traffic in hazardous wastes and other wastes, including through transboundary movements at sea. The Secretariat also supports the parties in reducing direct discharge or land runoff of hazardous pollutants or wastes into the marine and coastal environments, which can harm marine biodiversity and ecosystems ( The BRS Secretariat works closely with other relevant UN agencies, such as the International Maritime Organization and the Division for Ocean Affairs and the Law of the Sea, to ensure coherence and synergies in addressing these issues (
